tools.name: create_upload_session
tools.description: Use this only when the user explicitly wants an original production file delivered to objekts and the current host cannot pass that original file natively. It creates a short-lived private upload URL. Do not use it merely to analyze files that are already available in the conversation.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_production_brief_status · Private data: diagnose_production, estimate_production, create_upload_session, submit_production_brief, update_production_brief, delete_production_brief · Public sink: diagnose_production, estimate_production, create_upload_session, submit_production_brief, update_production_brief · Destructive: get_production_brief_status, delete_production_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_production_brief_status · Private data: diagnose_production, estimate_production, create_upload_session, submit_production_brief, update_production_brief, delete_production_brief · Public sink: diagnose_production, estimate_production, create_upload_session, submit_production_brief, update_production_brief · Destructive: get_production_brief_status, delete_production_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
